blind.description: A stylized wooden tailor's display shelf or cabinet stocked with textiles and haberdashery. The top shelf holds a rolled red bolt of cloth, a folded stack of cream-colored fabric, a rolled green bolt, and two reddish-brown hats on small display stands. The middle shelf contains an orange fabric roll, folded red fabric, a purple fabric roll, and a wooden rack of ribbon spools. The bottom open shelf holds folded green fabric, a rolled cream textile, folded purple cloth, and a rolled red textile above a bottom panelled section. The model has solid, continuous geometry with smooth stylized cartoon surfaces, resting flat on four corner leg posts without an added base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden top displaying four items side-by-side: a dark red fabric cylinder, a rectangular cream folded fabric block, a dark green fabric cylinder, and two dark red brimmed hats set closely together on the right side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.2 feet (1.0 m) tall, reaching just over waist height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about 3.3 feet (1.0 m) wide.
